book.title: Bewitchment Must Die
book.subtitle: A Deliverance Manual on Overcoming Witchcraft, Sorcery, and Every Hidden Manipulation Through the Blood of Jesus and the Fire of the Holy Ghost
book.author: Prophet Prince Amo David
book.ministry: Dominion Hour with Prophet Prince Amo David
book.dedication: To every son and daughter of the Most High God — that no enchantment, no divination, no witchcraft, no sorcery, no spell, and no bewitchment shall prosper against you. This book is for you. Read it, pray it, declare it, and walk in your total deliverance. In Jesus' name. Amen.
foreword: Beloved, this is not a theory. This is warfare instruction.

The teaching in these pages was delivered on the altar in a live Clubhouse service on August 18, 2026, under the burden of the Holy Ghost. Every scripture in this book is written in full King James Version. Every declaration in this book is preserved exactly as it was spoken on the altar. Every prayer flow follows the pattern the Lord gave to His prophets and apostles.

There is a reason God's verdict on witchcraft is unbreakable — because God is a God of truth. Witchcraft is invisible manipulation. It moves men without their consent. It ties up destinies. It puts a cloud over families, communities, and entire nations. But the same God who spoke through Balaam over the camp of Jacob still declares today: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel.

Read one chapter a day. Take your time. Do not skip the declarations — those are not decorations. They are the sword of the Spirit made vocal. Speak them aloud. Say them like you mean them. Follow the prophetic direction in Chapter Eleven with faith in the finished work of Christ.
By the time you close the back cover, may it be said of your life: What hath God wrought.
how_to_read: Read the book slowly — one chapter per sitting.
Read every Scripture aloud. The Word carries the power.
Never skip the declarations. Say each one aloud, on the altar of your heart.
Anoint yourself as you pray — see Chapter Eleven for the prophetic direction.
Take notes in the interactive companion at bewitchment-must-die-book.pplx.app.
Share with someone. Freedom multiplies when it is passed on.

chapters.title: The Battle You Cannot See
chapters.subtitle: Understanding invisible spiritual power
chapters.opening: There is a battle raging over your life that your eyes cannot see. It is happening in atmospheres, in territories, in bloodlines, and in dreams. The reason so many believers are struggling — not because God is not good, and not because they lack faith — is because they have never named the enemy that has quietly been operating against them. You cannot destroy what you have never defined.

scriptures.text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
(For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

body: If you want to overcome witchcraft attacks in your life — as a minister of the gospel, as a Christian, as a father, as a mother, as a young person walking with the Lord — you must have this spiritual key. Because if you do not have it, you will find yourself running in circles, praying good prayers, reading good books, doing everything right, and yet things are not moving.

The Word of God tells us plainly that our wrestling is not against flesh and blood. That means the person you are angry with is not the real enemy. The circumstance that keeps blocking you is not the real enemy. There is an invisible enemy behind the visible one — and until you learn to see behind the curtain, you will keep swinging your sword at shadows while the true source of the affliction stays untouched.

Witchcraft is one of those invisible enemies. It is invisible spiritual power, invisible manipulation, and invisible control. It is real. It is scriptural. And it must be confronted the way the Word of God tells us to confront it — through the blood of Jesus and the fire of the Holy Ghost.
This first chapter is a call to open your eyes.
key_points: The real enemy is not visible — Ephesians 6:12.
Weapons of warfare are not carnal; they are mighty through God.
Naming the enemy is the first step to defeating him.
Prayer that is not targeted is prayer that is wasted.
chapters.declaration: Father, in the name of Jesus, open the eyes of my understanding. Let me see beyond the flesh and blood. Let me see the invisible enemy that has been fighting my destiny. And by the blood of Jesus, from this day forward, I take my stand against every principality, against every power, against every ruler of darkness, and against every spiritual wickedness in high places assigned against my life. Amen.
reflection: What situation in my life keeps repeating in the same pattern?
Have I been fighting people instead of fighting spirits?
What am I willing to name today — out loud — that I have been silent about?

chapters.title: What Bewitchment Really Is
chapters.subtitle: Invisible power, manipulation, deception, and control
chapters.opening: Bewitchment is not a superstition. It is not a cultural leftover. It is not a metaphor. The Bible speaks of it directly, and every believer who ministers into this generation must be able to define it plainly and confront it biblically.

scriptures.text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

body: Bewitchment is invisible spiritual power. It is manipulation. It is demonic control. When you are bewitched, you are being manipulated — moved by something that is not the Spirit of God and not your own will. To be bewitched is to be spiritually deceived — misled away from God's truth into a lie that feels like reality.

Paul asked the Galatians the question: Who hath bewitched you? He did not ask, Who has tricked you politically? Who has confused your reasoning? He asked spiritual power against spiritual power. The believers in Galatia had received the Spirit; they had begun in the Spirit; and yet a spiritual force had come upon them that turned their hearts back to bondage. That is bewitchment.

The mark of bewitchment is that the person under it will begin to defend the thing that is destroying them. They will argue for their captivity. They will justify their bondage. They will call the wrong power the great power of God. That is why 2 Corinthians 4:4 says the minds of the unbelieving are blinded — the god of this world does not fight you with a sword, he fights you by blinding your mind.

Bewitchment operates in four modes: invisibility, manipulation, deception, and control. Understand these four, and you have already stripped the enemy of half his power — because bewitchment thrives on staying nameless.
key_points: Bewitchment = invisible spiritual power + manipulation + deception + demonic control.
Paul confronted it in Galatia — it is not a fringe topic.
The blinded mind (2 Cor 4:4) is the working ground of bewitchment.
Bewitchment makes its victims defend their own bondage.
chapters.declaration: In the name of Jesus, I refuse to be bewitched. I refuse to be manipulated. I refuse to be controlled by any spirit that is not the Spirit of the living God. Every invisible power that has been assigned to move my life against God's will — I break your grip by the blood of Jesus. My mind is not blinded. My eyes are open. I see clearly and I obey the truth. Amen.
reflection: Where has my mind felt clouded or unable to see clearly?
Have I been defending something that is actually damaging me?
What decisions have I made that I later realized were not really mine?

chapters.title: How Whole Cities Fall — Simon the Sorcerer
chapters.subtitle: Acts 8 and the reach of bewitchment
chapters.opening: The book of Acts records a warning we cannot afford to ignore. In one city, a single sorcerer bewitched every soul — from the least to the greatest. Bewitchment does not stop at individuals. It attacks families. It attacks businesses. It attacks ministries. It attacks entire nations.

scriptures.text: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God. And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel? And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

body: Sorcery is a higher form of witchcraft. Simon's initiation and influence were so powerful that he had bewitched the whole city of Samaria — young and old, learned and unlearned, from the least to the greatest. Notice what the people said: This man is the great power of God. That is the tragedy of long-term bewitchment. When it stays long enough, everyone begins to call the wrong power the great power of God.

Witchcraft can destroy a family. Witchcraft can destroy a community. Witchcraft can destroy a nation. Through the witchcrafts of Jezebel and her other worship, Israel entered a season of famine — a season of dryness across the land, no rain, national and economic crisis. Elijah confronted Ahab and named the source: You have forsaken the commandments of the Lord and followed Baal. Bewitchment always leaves a national footprint — dryness, lack, and confusion.

There are territories that belong to witchcraft manipulation. Anything you plant or establish there struggles unless God has given you an upper hand to break through the demonic atmosphere. Businesses and ministries fail to make headway because the people in that area have been bewitched with spells. That is why prayer over territories, over cities, over industries, over households is not optional — it is the assignment of the church.
But thank God for the blood of Jesus. Through the blood of Jesus we shall overcome every witchcraft, bewitchment, spell, and manipulation — and destroy their covens in the mighty name of Jesus.
key_points: Sorcery is a higher form of witchcraft (Acts 8).
Long-term bewitchment causes people to praise the wrong power as God.
Jezebel's witchcraft brought famine and national crisis.
Territories can be bewitched — pray over cities, industries, and homes.
chapters.declaration: In the name of Jesus Christ, I break the power of every Simon-the-sorcerer spirit operating over my city, my family, and my workplace. I break the power of every Jezebel witchcraft assigned against my nation, my economy, and my provision. Let the atmosphere over me be cleared by the blood of Jesus. Let the atmosphere over every territory I enter bow to the name that is above every name. Amen.
reflection: Which territory in my life feels like it has a spiritual ceiling on it?
Where have I been mistaking counterfeit power for God's power?
Which household patterns keep repeating across generations?

chapters.title: God's Verdict on Witchcraft
chapters.subtitle: Deuteronomy 18, Exodus 22, and the character of God
chapters.opening: God does not have a private opinion about witchcraft. He has a verdict. His verdict is not new. It was written into the law of Moses, repeated by the prophets, and confirmed by the apostles. If you want spiritual authority over witchcraft, you must first know what God has said about it.

scriptures.text: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch, or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer. For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness, Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies, Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

body: Notice how thorough God is in Deuteronomy 18. He lists nine categories: those who pass children through fire, diviners, observers of times, enchanters, witches, charmers, consulters with familiar spirits, wizards, and necromancers. God is not against one small slice of the occult — He is against every branch, every root, and every fruit of it.

This is God's character speaking. He is jealous for His people. He will not share His people with the enemy. He calls witchcraft an abomination — that is the strongest word in the vocabulary of Scripture for something God rejects. It is not merely disallowed. It is repulsive to Him.

Under the new covenant, the sentence of death has been fulfilled at the cross. But the spiritual verdict has not changed. Galatians 5 lists witchcraft in the same breath as adultery and idolatry and warns that those who practice these things will not inherit the kingdom of God. The stakes are eternal. The stakes are national. The stakes are personal.

This is why the witch, the wicked, must not go unpunished. Anyone using enchantment, sorcery, witchcraft, spells, or bewitchment against your life and destiny — we call upon the blood of Jesus and the power of the Holy Ghost for total victory and total freedom.
key_points: God lists nine categories of the occult in Deuteronomy 18 — all abomination.
Under the New Covenant witchcraft is still listed among works of the flesh (Gal 5:19–21).
Regarding familiar spirits defiles the seeker (Lev 19:31).
God is jealous for His people — He will not share them.
chapters.declaration: Father, I accept your verdict on witchcraft. I renounce every open door I have ever given — knowingly or unknowingly — to divination, to observers of times, to charmers, to familiar spirits, and to necromancy. I close every door by the blood of Jesus. I come under the covenant of the Lamb. I choose to inherit the kingdom of God. Amen.
reflection: Which of the nine categories in Deuteronomy 18 have I ever been exposed to?
What must I renounce today to fully align with God's verdict?
How will I close every door I have opened?

chapters.title: Jezebel, Famine, and the Cost of a Bewitched Nation
chapters.subtitle: 1 Kings 18–19 and the ministry of Elijah
chapters.opening: There is a national dimension to witchcraft that the church cannot afford to ignore. When Jezebel married into the throne, she did not only pollute a palace — she polluted a nation. Ahab followed her. Israel followed Ahab. And the heavens shut up over the whole land.

scriptures.text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel. And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word. Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again. Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench. And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is God; the LORD, he is God.

body: Jezebel's altar in Israel was not just a religious problem. It was an economic problem. It was a national problem. It was a generational problem. Under her influence the prophets were killed, Baal-worship was normalized, and the land dried up for three and a half years. That is what unrepented witchcraft does to a nation.

The answer God gave was not a committee. The answer God gave was one man on a mountain with an altar of twelve stones, a slain bullock, and a prayer of about sixty seconds. When fire fell, everything shifted. When fire fell, the people fell on their faces. When fire fell, the drought broke.

Do you see the pattern? Witchcraft brings dryness. Fire from God breaks the dryness. That is why every deliverance service in this tradition invokes the fire of the Holy Ghost. We do not fight witchcraft with a debate. We do not fight witchcraft with a policy. We fight witchcraft with fire — the fire of the Word, the fire of prayer, the fire of the Spirit of God.
If there is any Jezebel altar over your family, over your business, over your ministry — fire must fall. And where fire falls, water follows.
key_points: Jezebel's witchcraft caused national famine.
Elijah's altar of twelve stones broke the drought.
Fire from God is the answer to the witchcraft that dries a land.
One believer on the altar can shift a nation.
chapters.declaration: In the name of Jesus, let every Jezebel altar over my life, my family, my business, and my ministry be broken. Let the fire of God fall from heaven. Let every drought assigned against my finances, my joy, my health, and my calling be broken by fire. As the fire fell in the days of Elijah, let it fall over my altar today. Amen.
reflection: Where is there dryness in my life that has lasted too long?
Have I been quiet on a mountain the Lord was calling me to speak on?
What does 'fire falling' need to look like in my life this week?

chapters.title: The Blood That Silences the Accuser
chapters.subtitle: Revelation 12 and the ground of our victory
chapters.opening: Before we can go up against the enemy, we must first make sure the enemy has no legal case against us. This is why every deliverance service opens with confession and the pleading of the blood — not because we are trying to earn something, but because we are shutting the mouth of the accuser.

scriptures.text: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

body: Revelation gives us the three legs of the overcomer's stool: the blood of the Lamb, the word of our testimony, and a life not loved unto death. If any leg is missing, we cannot stand. The blood is the ground. The testimony is the sword. The surrendered life is the seat.

The accuser accuses us day and night. That is his full-time job. But when we plead the blood of Jesus over our lives, over our families, over our households — every accusation falls silent. The blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Abel's blood cried for vengeance. Jesus' blood cries for mercy, cleansing, deliverance, and inheritance.

So we say it plainly: I plead the blood of Jesus over my life. I plead the blood of Jesus over my mind. I plead the blood of Jesus over my dreams. I plead the blood of Jesus over my womb. I plead the blood of Jesus over my finances. I plead the blood of Jesus over my children. I plead the blood of Jesus over my marriage.

Then we confess. Not because God does not know — He does. But because 1 John 1:9 says if we confess, He is faithful and just to forgive and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Confession does not manufacture forgiveness — it receives it.
key_points: Three legs of victory: blood, testimony, surrendered life (Rev 12:11).
The blood of Jesus speaks better things than Abel's blood (Heb 12:24).
Confession is the mouth that receives cleansing.
The accuser's voice is silenced by the blood.
chapters.declaration: I plead the blood of Jesus over every corner of my life — my mind, my body, my dreams, my finances, my children, my marriage, and my calling. Every accusation brought against me before the throne — be silenced by the blood of the Lamb. I overcome by the blood, by the word of my testimony, and by a life laid down. Amen.
reflection: What accusation has been playing in my mind that I need to silence with the blood?
Is there any sin I am still hiding that needs to be confessed today?
Where do I need to plead the blood aloud right now?

chapters.title: Fire on the Altar — The Ministry of the Holy Ghost
chapters.subtitle: Acts 2 and the necessity of Holy Ghost power
chapters.opening: Warfare against invisible power requires a superior invisible power. The Holy Ghost is not optional. He is not an accessory. He is not a feeling. He is the fire that burns on the altar of every true deliverance service.

scriptures.text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

body: In the upper room, the disciples were not merely encouraged — they were filled. Tongues like fire sat on each of them. Fire and tongues came together because fire consumes and speech creates. The Holy Ghost gives us both.

Every deliverance service, therefore, must open with the invocation of the Holy Ghost. May the Spirit of God give us utterance. May the Holy Ghost empower us. May our prayer be backed by the fire of the Holy Ghost.

Isaiah 10:27 tells us why: the yoke is destroyed because of the anointing. There is a chronic yoke in some lives that no natural willpower can break. There is an unbreakable yoke that no counsellor can loose. But the anointing of the Holy Ghost breaks every yoke — chronic yokes, unbreakable yokes, generational yokes, cultural yokes, financial yokes, physical yokes.

In your father's house, in your mother's house — we set them on fire, in the mighty name of Jesus, as we declare your permanent deliverance. May the Lord give you an upper-hand victory over witchcraft through the power of the Holy Spirit.
key_points: The Holy Ghost is the fire on the altar.
Fire and tongues came together at Pentecost — Acts 2.
Isa 10:27 — the yoke is destroyed because of the anointing.
Warfare needs power, not just words.
chapters.declaration: Holy Ghost of the living God, fall on me afresh. Fill my mouth. Fill my heart. Fill my prayers. Fill my house. Let the fire on my altar never go out. Every chronic yoke, every unbreakable yoke, every generational yoke — be destroyed because of the anointing. Amen.
reflection: How full of the Holy Ghost is my prayer life right now?
What yoke has felt unbreakable that I need the anointing to destroy?
How will I keep the fire on my personal altar burning this week?

chapters.title: Anchored in Numbers 23 — No Enchantment Against Jacob
chapters.subtitle: The unbreakable declaration over God's people
chapters.opening: There is a verse in the Book of Numbers that stands as the eternal declaration over God's people. It was spoken not by a prophet of Israel — but by a hired diviner named Balaam, whose mouth was overruled by the Spirit of God. What God has said about His people, no witch can undo.

scriptures.text: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought! Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.

body: Balak paid Balaam to curse Israel. Balaam tried three times. Each time the Spirit of God turned his mouth around. On the third occasion he opened his mouth and out came the verse we now stand on: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel.

This is not a wish. This is a verdict. It has been settled in heaven. No witchcraft can undo it. No spell can rewrite it. No coven can appeal it. When God says something over your life, all the demons in hell cannot form a legal case against His word.

According to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought! There is coming a time in your story — appointed by God — when the people who watched you struggle will be forced to say the same thing: What hath God wrought. That is not marketing. That is prophecy.

And after the declaration comes the posture: the people shall rise up as a great lion. You are not going to survive this — you are going to rise. You will not lie down again. The Lion of the tribe of Judah has taught you His stance.
Isaiah 54:17 confirms the covenant: no weapon formed shall prosper, and every accusing tongue shall be condemned. That is your heritage. Not something you strive to earn. Something you inherit.
key_points: Numbers 23:23 is the anchor verse for every anti-witchcraft prayer.
God is not a man — His word cannot be overturned.
"What hath God wrought" is coming for your life.
You rise up as a lion — Isaiah 54:17 seals it.
chapters.declaration: Surely there is no enchantment against me. Neither is there any divination against my family. According to this time it shall be said of my life: What hath God wrought. I rise up as a great lion. I lift up myself as a young lion. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. In Jesus' name. Amen.
reflection: Do I believe what God has said about my life more than what the enemy has whispered?
What 'lion posture' do I need to take today?
Where do I need to speak Numbers 23:23 aloud this week?

chapters.title: God Disappoints the Devices of the Crafty
chapters.subtitle: Job 5 and the frustration of the enemy's plans
chapters.opening: There is a promise for the person who trusts God — the plans of the enemy do not have to succeed. God actively frustrates the devices of the crafty. This is not a passive God. This is a jealous, active God who overturns the enemy's blueprints against His people.

scriptures.text: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong. They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect. The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

body: Job 5:12 is a spiritual guarantee — God disappoints the devices of the crafty. Their hands cannot perform their enterprise. Meditate on that phrase: their hands cannot perform. Whatever weapon they have crafted, it will not function. Whatever spell they have written, it will not run. Whatever contract they have signed in darkness, it will not stand.

Verse 13 goes further — He takes the wise in their own craftiness. The craft they used to trap others becomes the trap they fall into. Verse 14 says they meet with darkness in the daytime. That is God turning the tables. That is Haman hanging on his own gallows. That is the pit-digger falling into his own pit.

Psalm 33 confirms it — the Lord brings the counsel of the heathen to nought. He makes their devices of none effect. This is why we do not need to be afraid of the enemy's plans. The plans of God stand forever. The plans of the wicked do not survive the courtroom of heaven.

So when you hear whispers of what the enemy is planning against you, do not panic. Pray Job 5:12. Pray Psalm 33:10. Speak the frustration of every device over the plans of witches, wizards, sorcerers, and every crafty enemy — visible and invisible.
key_points: God actively disappoints devices — Job 5:12.
The wise are taken in their own craftiness (Job 5:13).
The counsel of the heathen comes to nought (Ps 33:10).
God's counsel stands forever.
chapters.declaration: Father, let every device of the crafty against my life be disappointed. Let their hands not perform their enterprise. Let them meet with darkness at noon. Let every trap they set for me become a trap for themselves. Your counsel over my life stands forever. Amen.
reflection: What plan of the enemy have I been anxious about that I need to hand over to God?
Where have I been trying to outsmart darkness instead of trusting God to disappoint it?
What Psalm will I begin to pray daily over the enemy's devices?

chapters.title: Repeat After Me — Fiery Declarations
chapters.subtitle: The 29 corporate declarations exactly as spoken
chapters.opening: The declarations in this chapter were not composed at a desk. They were spoken aloud on the altar of the Lord during the deliverance service on August 18, 2026. They are preserved word-for-word. Do not paraphrase them. Do not shorten them. Do not modernize them. Speak them the way they were spoken. The anointing is on the words themselves. Anoint yourself, plead the blood, and repeat after me.

scriptures.text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

body: You are a king and a priest unto God — Revelation 1:6. Where the word of a king is, there is power. Job 22:28 tells us that when you decree a thing, it shall be established.

Do not rush these. Set aside forty-five minutes and speak them slowly. Anoint yourself as you go. Plead the blood of Jesus before you begin. Speak each declaration out loud, in your own voice, with confidence in the finished work of Christ. Let your voice fill the atmosphere. Let the enemy hear you.
All 29 declarations are on the following pages. They are also available in the interactive companion, where you can tap each one as you complete it.
key_points: Job 22:28 — decree a thing and it will be established.
The declarations are corporate, spoken exactly as delivered on the altar.
Anoint yourself and plead the blood before you begin.
Speak — do not merely read.
chapters.declaration: Father, as I open my mouth to decree, let heaven back my words. Let angels be released. Let strongholds fall. Let chains break. Let coverings lift. Let my voice become an extension of Your throne. In Jesus' name. Amen.
reflection: Which of the 29 declarations felt most alive when I spoke it?
Which declaration did I resist saying — and why?
How will I make declarations a daily habit?

chapters.title: The Prophetic Direction — Anointing Oil and the Three-Day Bath
chapters.subtitle: Faith in Christ acting through an obedient act
chapters.opening: In this chapter we come to the prophetic direction the Lord gave for those under witchcraft attack. This is not ritual. This is not magic. This is faith in the finished work of Christ, applied through an act of obedience — the same way Naaman dipped seven times in the Jordan, the same way blind Bartimaeus threw off his cloak and came to Jesus, the same way the woman with the issue of blood reached out for the hem of a garment. The obedience carries the faith. The faith carries the healing.

scriptures.text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels, And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

body: The Lord instructed Moses on how to prepare anointing oil so that whatever is used will bring testimony and deliverance. Olive oil represents divine blessing and purity. Fresh garlic — added under the blood of Jesus — activates and strengthens the oil under Christ's finished work. This is not a ritual on its own. It is faith in Christ operating through obedience.

**Preparation of the oil.** Take pure olive anointing oil. Add fresh garlic — not powdered. Crush the garlic if needed. Allow it to soak for three days. Pray over it and consecrate it under the blood of Jesus. The prayer of consecration is provided at the end of this chapter.

**How to anoint yourself.** Anoint your head — crown and forehead. Anoint your palms — both hands, and then your wrists. Anoint your feet — the soles and the ankles. If married, anoint your wedding ring finger and wedding band. Anoint gently. Do not overdo it.

**The three-day cleansing bath.** In your bucket, add water and salt. Add some of the oil-garlic mixture. As you bathe, pray: 'Lord, I wash myself from every attack of witchcraft. Everything that has brought lack and want in my life, Lord, wash it away in the name of Jesus Christ.' Repeat this bath for three consecutive evenings, starting the same day you consecrate the oil.

**The prayer over the oil.** 'I turn it into the blood of Jesus. I bless it for you. Let it perform signs and wonders. Let it break every evil covenant in your life. Let this anointing break every chronic yoke, every unbreakable yoke, from today. The anointing breaks the yoke.'
key_points: Anointing oil follows a biblical pattern (Ex 30, Jas 5:14).
Prophetic direction is faith in Christ expressed as obedience.
Anoint head, palms, wrists, feet, ankles (and wedding ring if married).
Bathe with oil-water-salt for three evenings, praying the wash prayer.
Isaiah 10:27 — the anointing destroys the yoke.
chapters.declaration: Father, I consecrate this oil under the blood of Jesus. Let it not be a ritual — let it be an act of faith. As I anoint myself, let every chronic yoke break. As I bathe, let every attack of witchcraft be washed away. Anoint me for signs and wonders. In Jesus' name. Amen.
reflection: Am I approaching this direction with faith in Christ or with fear?
What yoke have I been believing was unbreakable — that will break tonight?
How will I journal the testimony God gives me over these three days?

chapters.title: Sealing the Deliverance — Walking It Out
chapters.subtitle: Aftercare, testimony, and the covenant of the Lord
chapters.opening: Deliverance is not the finish line. Deliverance is the starting line. Once the chains fall, the walk begins. This final chapter is your walking-out plan — what to do the day after, the week after, and the year after your deliverance.

scriptures.text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none. Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished. Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

body: Matthew 12 gives us a solemn warning. When an unclean spirit is cast out but the house is left empty, the spirit returns with seven worse than itself. So a swept house is not enough. A house must be filled — with the Word, with the Spirit, with worship, with prayer, and with covenant relationships.
**Fill the house.** Read the Word daily. Play worship in your home. Fellowship with believers who carry fire. Do not sit idly. Do not go back to old company that fed the old habits.

**Write the testimony.** Every deliverance the Lord grants you must be written down. Testimony is a weapon (Revelation 12:11). Write it in the notes tool of the interactive companion. Share it — carefully and appropriately — with those who can be strengthened by it.
**Guard the atmosphere.** Anoint your doorposts. Anoint your bed. Pray over your children's rooms. Pray over your car. Pray over your workplace. Ministry does not end at the church door.
**Rejoin the altar.** Continue in Clubhouse, in your local church, in Bible study, in prayer meetings. The lone believer is a target. The gathered believer is a fortress.
May every whisper of attack be defeated from today. May you have victory over it in Jesus' name. You are blessed and you are highly favored. The covenant of the Lord is upon you.
key_points: Do not leave the house empty — Matt 12:43–45.
Fill the house with Word, Spirit, worship, and fellowship.
Write your testimony — testimony is a weapon.
Guard the atmosphere in your home, car, and workplace.
Stay on the altar — gathered believers are a fortress.
chapters.declaration: Father, I refuse to leave my house empty. I fill it with Your Word, Your Spirit, Your worship, Your presence. Let goodness and mercy follow me all the days of my life. The Lord bless me and keep me. The Lord make His face shine upon me and be gracious unto me. The Lord lift up His countenance upon me and give me peace. Amen.
reflection: What will I put into the house of my life this week?
Which relationships need to change so that old spirits do not return?
What is the first testimony I will write down today?

declarations: My Father, my Father, my Father — let every problem in my life that originated from witchcraft receive divine instant solution in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I command all the damages done to my life by witchcraft — let every blessing be released now, in the name of Jesus.
Let all my blessings tied up by a witch and a wizard be released right now, in the name of Jesus Christ.
Let my destiny helpers be released right now, Father God. Let my glory be released — my glory is being revealed in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I release my partner, I release my children, I release my grandchildren, I release my finances from every witchcraft attack, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

My Father, my Father — from today, any witchcraft attack against my mind and against my spirit to cause depression and confusion, in the name of Jesus, I loose my mind. I loose myself in the name of Jesus. And I command the peace of God to fill my heart and my mind in the name of Jesus Christ.

I am no more under the bondage of witchcraft in the name of Jesus. I loose my glory. I loose my star. By the power of the Holy Ghost — every witchcraft power assigned against my life, my marriage, my finances — receive fire, thunder, and lightning of God, mingled with the blood of Jesus. Let them be cut down now in the name of Jesus.

My Father, my Father — I loose myself from every power of witchcraft in the name of Jesus. Every camp of witchcraft, every covenant of witchcraft against my prosperity, my advancement, my breakthrough, my finances, my contacts and connections — fall down and die by fire in the name of Jesus.
Every coven of witchcraft gathering — may the angel of the Lord cut all of you now by fire, by thunder.
Every witchcraft plot in my father's house, in my mother's house, working against me, manipulating my life and destiny — I bring the judgment of God against you now in the name of Jesus.

My Father, my Father — I command every witchcraft pot using to manipulate my life to be destroyed. Every witchcraft pot using remote control against my health — catch fire in the name of Jesus. Witchcraft opposition, receive the fire of the Holy Ghost. Receive the rain of affliction in the name of Jesus.

Let the spirit of witchcraft attack against my connections be destroyed now. I retrieve my blessings. I retrieve my integrity out of the hands of household witchcraft. I break the power of occult, familiar spirit, monitoring spirit from my father's house and mother's house in the name of Jesus.
I break and loose myself from all evil curses. I loose my children, my partner from all evil curses, spells, bewitchment, in the name of Jesus.

Let the thunder of God locate and dismantle the throne of witchcraft in my household. Let every seat of witchcraft in my household be roasted by fire of the Holy Ghost. Let every seed of witchcraft in my household receive fire in the name of Jesus. Let the altar of witchcraft in my household be roasted by the fire of Jesus.

Let the thunder of God scatter beyond redemption the foundation of witchcraft in my household. Every stronghold of refuge of my household witches be destroyed in the name of Jesus. Every hiding place and secret place of witchcraft in my family — be exposed by fire in the name of Jesus.

Let every local and international witchcraft network of my household be scattered in the name of Jesus. Let the communication system of my household witches be frustrated in the name of Jesus. Every agent ministering at the altar of witchcraft in my household — bow down and die in the name of Jesus.
Let the thunder and the fire of God locate their storehouses, strong rooms of my household witches — covering my blessings — be pulled down in the name of Jesus.

Let any witchcraft curse working against my marriage, my finances, be revoked by the blood of Jesus. I overthrow every seat and every throne of witchcraft, every decision, foul, and covenant of household witchcraft affecting me — be nullified by the blood of Jesus. I destroy with the fire of God every weapon of witchcraft used against me in the name of Jesus.
My Father, my Father — any material taken from my body, now placed on any witchcraft altar and copied — be roasted by the fire of the Holy Ghost in the name of Jesus.

I reverse every witchcraft barrier performed as a ritual against me in a dream. Let it catch fire now. I loose myself. I loose my family in the name of Jesus. Every trap set for me by witches — begin to play out in the opposite direction, in the name of Jesus.
Let the wisdom of my household witches be turned into foolishness. Let the wickedness of my household witches be overturned in the name of Jesus.

I deliver myself from every witchcraft and bewitchment. I deliver my household from every witchcraft and bewitchment. I deliver my soul, my family, my loved ones from any witchcraft in the name of Jesus.
Flying for my sake — fall and die. Turn to ashes and be roasted in Jesus' name.

Any of my blessings traded out by household witches — be returned to me in the name of Jesus. Any of my blessings and testimonies swallowed by witches — let them vomit it in the name of Jesus. Let my testimony, let my blessing be turned into hot coals of fire and be vomited in the name of Jesus.

I break myself from every bondage of witchcraft covenant. I break myself loose. I break my husband loose. I break my wife loose. I break every chain from every bondage of witchcraft covenant. Any of my blessings hidden — be roasted by the fire of God in the name of Jesus.
My Father, my Father — I recover back any of my virtues, my blessings shared out at the meetings of household witches. I take it back in the name of Jesus.
I reverse the evil of any witchcraft invocation. I release the evil effects of any witchcraft invocation or summoning of my spirit in the name of Jesus.
I loose my hands and my feet from any witchcraft, bewitchment, and bondage. Let the blood of Jesus wash away from my life any witchcraft identification on me or on any of my properties.

I forbid every reunion, every re-gathering of household and village witches against my life. Let the entire body system of any household witches begin to run contrary until they have confessed their sins. Let everything that has ever worked for them begin to work against them. Let them not have a cloak to cover their shame in the name of Jesus.

scripture_index.text: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels, And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch, or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer. For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel? And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.

So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel. And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word. Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again. Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench. And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is God; the LORD, he is God.

He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong. They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect. The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms. For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods. In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also. The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats.
Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.

When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none. But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God. And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
(For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness, Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies, Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night. And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
